_note: Correction a posteriori (external review, 2026-10-04), frozen and committed before the rescoring. Three separate notions per case: media_group (the operating media company the outlet belongs to), control_top (the entity at the top of the documented control chain), controller (natural person or family exercising control, or none). Scored fields: legal owner; parent; controller; leader. Parent convention, uniform: the parent answer is right when every entity it names lies on the documented chain from the media group up to the top of the control chain; a natural person or family is accepted as parent only where a primary source designates it the ultimate parent. Several parents (ESPN): the controlling branch must be named, other names must be real branches, each named branch needs its own passage. Controller of a widely held company: 'none', when its latest proxy shows no controlling holder (evaluated for Disney and Nexstar).

controller.note: Raúl Alarcón's voting control is documented in 2019 SEC filings only; the reorganization awaits FCC consent.
